title: linociera tetrandra
intro: Linociera tetrandra, commonly known as the "Mast Tree" or "Gamboge Tree", is a plant species native to Southeast Asia, particularly in the tropical forests of Myanmar and Thailand. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Linociera tetrandra are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include xanthones, flavonoids, and triterpenes that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The xanthones present in the plant, particularly gambogic acid, have been shown to possess significant therapeutic potential in treating cancer, cardiovascular diseases, and neurodegenerative disorders.
